title: Gamepad Tank Drive

hints.title: Why negate the Y value?
hints.content: Pushing the joystick forward produces a negative value (e.g., -0.8). Since we want forward stick to mean forward motor power (positive), we negate it: `-gamepad1.left_stick_y` turns -0.8 into 0.8.

hints.title: How to read gamepad input
hints.content: Access gamepad values directly as fields: `gamepad1.left_stick_y` and `gamepad1.right_stick_y`. No method call needed -- they are public fields.

hints.title: Setting motor power from a variable
hints.content: Store the corrected value in a variable first, then pass it to setPower: `double leftPower = -gamepad1.left_stick_y;` then `leftMotor.setPower(leftPower);`
